sic_on_the_tree.L2: SIC division (first two digits) as a check on the heading
sic_on_the_tree.L3: the fund's holdings' SIC codes, counted
sic_on_the_tree.L4: majority SIC and the odd ones out on the card

home_path_rule: 1 the ADOPTED cohort that claims it; if several, the one whose industry (by the authority) matches, then the smallest
2 else the PROPOSED cohort that claims it
3 else the FUND SET of the industry fund holding it at the highest weight
4 else the sector heading's NONE YET line
theme beats size: a size cohort (MEGACAP) is 'also in', never home, when an industry cohort claims the name
also_in_edges: comp-set edge: the name is in another company's kept set (new)

proposal_rule.shared_industry: same FMP industry, or the same SIC code where FMP's label spans several
proposal_rule.shared_funds: at least one industry fund holds ≥ half of the set
proposal_rule.co_movement: mean pair correlation of the close-Geiger readings over N sessions above the 95th point of 200 random draws of the same size from the served universe

cohorts.naming_rule: upper snake id; label = the parenting fund's theme in plain words where Alan named it, else the SIC description in plain words; ≤ 3 words; never a vendor label verbatim; a split keeps the parent's first word
states: FUND SET (an industry fund's served holdings, automatic)
cohorts.promotion: 20 consecutive passing nights → put to Alan; 20 failing → withdrawn; nothing adopts or dissolves itself (R5)
cohorts.move_rule: leave-one-out: another cohort's mean tracks the name better than its own by ≥ 0.10 → listed; Alan decides

dry_run_1oct.stand_in: 60 sessions of daily close returns (chart API) + today's three-rung scout for the one-day agreement

cohorts.dependency: P8 (seven-rung close Geiger) for the co-movement half

candidates: same industry by the authority (the screener; served names today)
served holdings of the industry funds that hold the company

keep.same_industry: FMP industry equal, or the same SIC code
keep.fund_is: a vote, never an industry match (departs from C4 as built)
keep.thin_set_rule: fewer than 5 survive at ×10 → widen one step, say so

comp_sets.operator: public.comps_decisions on top; a switched-off peer stays listed, greyed, out of the medians
comp_sets.outliers: per measure, beyond 1.5 × IQR of the peers' middle half → flag only (July spec §1); never removed by the rule

agreement_view.flat: rows = candidates by votes then closeness; columns = the four sources; the kept band shaded; a verdict per row
agreement_view.three_d: the company on the spine; rings by votes (1 bottom … 4 top); radius = closeness; angle = the source signature; the kept set = the bright inner ring; in the tree's 3D area a name lifts into its comp cloud

screener.rule: a filter over placement records: industry/SIC, size band, country, ADR, fund, measure ranges, Geiger range, cohort state; no provider call
screener.hub_tab: the SCREENER tab is a view of it, with 'use as comp set' and 'show on the tree'
screener.comps: the fourth comps source is this screen with industry = the company's and size inside the band
